test-integration.description: Run Docker-backed repository integration tests (testcontainers Postgres). Requires a running Docker daemon.

db:studio.description: Open Drizzle Studio for database management

db:push.description: Push schema changes directly to database (dev only)

db:drop.description: Drop all tables (DANGER: use with caution)

db:seed.description: Seed database with initial data (dev client)

db:seed-oauth-clients.description: Idempotent OAuth-client provisioner, and scope grants for CIMD clients — pass `-- --manifest=<path> [--rotate]`

events:verify-chain.description: Verify a realm's admin event chain and report the first broken event (#459): pass `-- (--realm=<name> | --realm-id=<uuid>) [--from-seq=<seq> --from-hash=<hex>] [--json]`. The script exits 0 when the chain verifies, 1 on a break, 2 on a usage error and 3 when the check could not run (#827), but Nx reports every failure as 1: a monitor runs `pnpm --dir libs/infra/db exec tsx src/scripts/verify-event-chain.ts` instead.

db:disable-user.description: Disable a user account and end every session and token it holds, or enable it again (#748): pass `-- --realm=<name> --user-id=<user id> [--enable]`
